actions.return_response.description: Return a file or text (markdown) as a response.
actions.return_response.props.file.descr: A file the person can download with the response.
actions.return_response.props.markdown.d: Shown to the person waiting. Markdown is supported.
description: Trigger a flow through human input.
triggers.chat_submission.description: Trigger the flow by sending a message
triggers.chat_submission.props.about.des:
**Published Chat URL:**
```text
{{chatUrl}}
```
Production link. Serves the published version of the chat.

**Draft Chat URL:**
```text
{{chatUrl}}?useDraft=true
```
Testing link. Serves the draft you are editing now.
Or press **Open Chat** in the builder to try it in a side panel.
triggers.chat_submission.props.botName.d: Shown in the greeting above the chat box.
triggers.chat_submission.props.responseM:
The sender waits for a **Respond on UI** step in this flow.
Without one, they see an error after {{webhookTimeoutSeconds}} seconds.
triggers.form_submission.description: Trigger the flow by submitting a form.
triggers.form_submission.props.about.des:
**Published Form URL:**
```text
{{formUrl}}
```
Production link. Serves the published version of the form.

**Draft Form URL:**
```text
{{formUrl}}?useDraft=true
```
Testing link. Serves the draft you are editing now.
triggers.form_submission.props.inputs.de: One row per field shown on the form.
With **Wait for Response** on, the form waits for a **Respond on UI** step.
Without one, it errors after {{webhookTimeoutSeconds}} seconds.
triggers.form_submission.props.waitForRe: Keeps the submitter on the form until the flow replies.
